## `labs/connector/provider/query_contract_definitions` { #labs-connector-provider-query_contract_definitions }

List the contract definitions the provider connector holds.

A definition is kept when its id starts with `id_prefix` or its selector names an asset starting with `asset_id_prefix`; with neither given, every definition is. Besides their ids it publishes the policies and assets the kept definitions bind, so a test can withdraw a whole offer — definition first, then its policies, then its assets — without knowing any of them.

**Inputs**

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Also accepts | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id_prefix` | string | no | `''` | — | Keep only the ids that start with this; empty keeps every one. |
| `asset_id_prefix` | string | no | `''` | — | Also keep a definition whose asset selector names an asset id that starts with this — the way to find an offer whose own id the connector generated. |

**Output** — the value assertions and `returns:` read

_Output contract of `labs/connector/provider/query_contract_definitions`._

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `contract_definition_ids` | list of string | Ids of the matching contract definitions, in the order listed. |
| `policy_ids` | list of string | Access and contract policies the matching definitions bind, once each. |
| `asset_ids` | list of string | Asset ids the matching definitions' selectors name, once each. |
